correctness.rationale: PASS: The plus-edge graph on K_n has incidence charges D_v=2k_v-(n-1), so the interaction is J/2(sum D_v^2-n(n-1)). A degree gap >=2 admits an edge transfer decreasing sum k_v^2; hence every fixed-m minimizer is near regular and exists. Exact differences E_n(m+1)-E_n(m) give the even and odd arithmetic critical field sets, including parity rollovers; at h=0 the all-odd or all-even charge constraint yields the stated M progressions. Independent enumeration of every labelled configuration for n=3,4,5,6 reproduces every sector minimum and the critical fields. J>0, n>=3, h real, total rather than density magnetization. This proves finite-volume/classical claims, not a bulk phase transition.
